reviews.title: Annoying mechanics
reviews.text: While the app does conveniently track hours, it constantly logs me out. Plus, the student account linked to a parent's is honestly kind of stupid. The student account can only look at the data, and can'r track any drives, so why have one in the first place? All you should need is one account to track it. Now that I am logged back in (on my parent's account because my mom prefers to use her phone in the car. Yes, you can't use your phone while running the app.) it says that there are no students invited, and comes up with a server code error when I try to invite my student account. The app has a lot of technical bugs that make it insufferable and I can't wait to get my license so I can stop using the damn thing.

reviews.title: Needs Much Work
reviews.text: This app needs some major work. It took me about an hour to pair with my parent. Once you log in as a student, you have to log in about once a day or it will log you out automatically and if you don’t log in for up to 2 weeks as a student, the account is just straight up DELETED. My parents use it and it’s the same thing. You basically have to log in every time you drive and it will even tell you that you can use Face ID but it NEVER works. Another issue is inputting manual drives is ABSOLUTELY TERRIBLE. Once you put it in it tells you the drive was 0 minutes and you have to do that a couple times until it finally does it. Another one is the weather during the drive is completely wrong half the time. Another thing is half the drives are night drives even though it’s questionable, it’s not always a bad thing but it’s worth talking about. Another issue is it’s after drive ratings that it gives you. It once gave me a 5/10 for speeding even though I didn’t go above 55 in a 55. It’s good for giving you an overall view of all your drives but not much else. Only slightly better then an excel or Google Sheets and a timer.

reviews.title: So Frustrating

We spend 10-20 minutes just trying to get this awful app working. I would find something else if I were you.

reviews.title: Great Concept, Poor Execution
reviews.text:
Road Ready Ohio is a great idea in theory, but the app itself is frustrating to use. It is not intuitive at all, and the setup process — especially connecting accounts — is confusing and time-consuming.

The manual logging feature is a major pain. I am not always with my child when he is driving — his dad takes him too — so we miss out on feedback for those sessions and I have to manually log them. Now the app won’t even let me log drives from the same day, which makes it even worse.

On top of that, the student can’t track drives from their own app, and I have to log in every single time instead of staying signed in. Nothing about the process feels smooth or user-friendly.

This app has a good concept, but it clearly needed much more development and testing before being rolled out statewide. Right now, it creates more stress than convenience for parents trying to help their kids learn to drive.
